The Roubic Gates Mills Story

Heritage-Village Tree Care Since 1982

Gates Mills is a small, affluent historic village in eastern Cuyahoga County — an equestrian community of large estate lots and a mature heritage canopy of oak, maple, and beech. Roubic has worked the village for decades, and the trees that make Gates Mills look like Gates Mills are exactly the trees our crews specialize in.

The context here matters: conservation easements, tree-protection ordinances, and heritage-tree designations shape almost every job. That's a fit with how Roubic operates — owner-supervised work, ANSI A300 pruning standards, and a full owned equipment fleet including crane capability for estate specimens.

Gates Mills homeowners want someone who knows which trees are protected and which streets the village allows access on. That local knowledge is the whole job — and it's why I still walk every estimate myself. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Permit handling in-house. Gates Mills requires a permit to remove healthy trees over 18 inches DBH in front yards or on conservation easements. Roubic assesses DBH before quoting, flags any permit-required trees, and pulls the permit on your behalf — filing fee billed at cost.

Common Gates Mills Questions

Gates Mills Tree Service FAQ

Six things Gates Mills homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Gates Mills, OH?
Yes — Gates Mills is part of Roubic's Tier 2 service area, about 10 miles from our Auburn Township yard. We've served the village since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How fast do you respond in Gates Mills?
Tier 2 areas like Gates Mills get next-day response on standard scheduled work and 2–4 hour response on storm and emergency calls from our Auburn Township yard. Our 24/7 emergency line is answered by a real person.
Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Gates Mills?
Gates Mills has one of the strictest village tree ordinances in Greater Cleveland. A permit is required to remove healthy trees over 18 inches DBH in front yards or on conservation easements. Hazardous and dead trees are exempt (we provide arborist documentation). Roubic assesses DBH before quoting and pulls any required permit on your behalf — the filing fee is billed at cost and disclosed upfront.
How much does tree removal cost in Gates Mills?
Tree removal in Gates Mills typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and on-site with confirmed pricing before you book.
Can you prune the oaks on my Gates Mills property?
Yes — we prune to ANSI A300 standards across every NE Ohio canopy species, including the heritage oaks, maples, and beech common in the village. To protect against oak wilt, we do not perform oak work April 1 through July 31; oak pruning is scheduled in the dormant season.
Do you work on estate and heritage-tree properties in Gates Mills?
Yes — estate and heritage-tree work has long been a Roubic specialty in Gates Mills. We keep ongoing customers on multi-tree maintenance schedules, coordinate with the village shade tree commission where heritage designations apply, and run owner-supervised jobs with a full owned equipment fleet. Roubic is licensed and insured, with a certificate of insurance available on request.
